title: Multiscale low-high cross-budget repair
statement: If a one-threshold boundary shorting constant is false or insufficient, construct a multiscale shorting state whose cross budgets telescope and remain compatible with positive-mu interpolation.

signature.representation: Nested spectral thresholds with shorted operators and harmonic low-high stitching
signature.state_or_invariant: A telescoping budget for cross blocks between adjacent spectral layers
signature.core_candidate_lemma: The sum of layerwise shorting losses is bounded by a universal fraction of the retained boundary inverse moment.
signature.target_implication: A telescoping multiscale floor repairs the R131 cross-budget edge and supplies a uniform stitch to C051, then C050.
signature.known_failure_mode: Layer count or harmonic stitching may accumulate logarithmic or dimensional loss, leaving no universal c.
signature.verifier_class: finite spectral-layer Schur identities plus rank-three positive and rank-four barrier controls
